title: Record the Schur cancellation of diagonal weights
body:
## Summary
- For every invertible 2×2 interior with entries in `{−1, 0, 1}` and every scale in `{1, 2, 3}`, the interior diagonal weights cancel in the Schur correction.
- The correction equals the boundary scale ratio times the unweighted correction, across 314,928 checks.
- The selected κ is unchanged.

## Test plan
